remarks: 3-Family House Listing in the Cove Area, Stamford, CT Spacious Multi-Family Opportunity Near the Waterfront Welcome to a rare opportunity in the heart of the coveted Cove neighborhood of Stamford, Connecticut. This charming and meticulously maintained three-family residence offers the perfect blend of investment potential and comfortable living, just moments from the sparkling waters of Long Island Sound and all the conveniences of coastal New England living. Nestled on a quiet, tree-lined street, this 3-family home boasts classic architectural details and modern amenities across its three spacious units. With generous living areas, updated kitchens, and private outdoor spaces, this property is ideal for extended families, owner-occupants seeking supplemental income, or investors looking for a prime rental location. The Cove area is renowned for its welcoming community spirit, scenic views, and proximity to Stamford's best amenities. Residents enjoy easy access to beaches, parks, marinas, and outdoor activities year-round. Commuting is a breeze with nearby highways (I-95, US-1) and Stamford's Metro-North station offering express service to Manhattan. Beaches: Walking distance to Cove Island Park and West Beach. Shopping & Dining: Minutes to downtown Stamford's vibrant restaurants, boutiques, and entertainment. Healthcare: Close to Stamford Hospital and medical offices. With its flexible layout and prime location, this property offers outstanding rental income.
